title: melasma luridum
intro: Melasma luridum, commonly known as the "yellow sea anemone" or "yellow sea fan", is a species of coral-like marine alga. It has been found to have various health benefits, including its potential to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Melasma luridum include its use in traditional medicine for wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Melasma luridum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
